assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: premium esports brand emblem for GRAILSHOT, a live multiplayer card aim/snipe game.
Primary request: create ONE original compact brand emblem fusing a sharp aiming crosshair, an angular letter G, and a trading-card silhouette into one coherent simple mark.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, isolated cutout, no backdrop or floor.
Style/medium: polished 3D enamel and metal emblem with crisp purposeful edges, premium competitive gaming identity. Bold simple silhouette recognizable at 40px; restrained depth, no tiny decorative detail.
Composition/framing: centered in a square canvas, emblem fills approximately 80 percent of canvas, fully visible with generous clear margin.
Color palette: electric cyan #4cc2ff and orange #ff8752, small graphite metal accents; clean high contrast.
Lighting/mood: controlled studio reflections and subtle dimensional highlights.
Constraints: no words or text; only the integrated angular G letterform. No existing brand marks, no Pokémon or Solana logos, no copyrighted character art, no watermark, no background effects.

Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: premium sealed trading-card pack render for GRAILSHOT treasury and prize preparation interface.
Primary request: ONE original sealed foil trading-card pack, premium science-fiction sports collectible packaging.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, clean isolated cutout, no floor or environmental scene.
Subject: portrait sealed foil card pack with realistic crimped foil seals at top and bottom, charcoal brushed foil body, bold cyan #4cc2ff and orange #ff8752 geometric targeting emblem integrated with angular G and card shape.
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic 3D product render, tactile metallic foil, restrained sharp studio highlights.
Composition/framing: frontal with slight three-quarter perspective, entire pack fully visible, centered, portrait silhouette and clear margins. The packaging front must be legible.
Text (verbatim): large clean geometric sans serif word "GRAILSHOT" (G R A I L S H O T) near upper front. Small precise tagline "HOLD. AIM. WIN." near lower front. These are the only words.
Constraints: clean strong design with minimal readable text, no extra labels or fake microtext; no copyrighted characters; no Pokémon or Solana logos; no other brand logos; no watermark; no external shadow panel or backdrop.
